instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Modelling: Context, DFD, ER and Use Cases
topic_ar: النمذجة: السياق والتدفق والكيانات وحالات الاستخدام

questions.question: A context diagram explains...
questions.explanation: The context diagram shows the system as one bubble with its external entities around it.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط السياق يعرض النظام كفقاعة واحدة تحيط بها كياناته الخارجية.

questions.question: DFD stands for...
questions.explanation: DFD is the Data Flow Diagram, which traces data moving through processes and stores.
questions.explanation_ar: DFD هو مخطط تدفق البيانات، وهو يتتبع البيانات بين العمليات والمخازن.

questions.question: A level-0 DFD is similar to...
questions.question_ar: مخطط التدفق من المستوى صفر يشبه...
questions.explanation: Level 0 shows the whole system against its environment, which is what a context diagram does.
questions.explanation_ar: المستوى صفر يعرض النظام كله مقابل بيئته، وهذا ما يفعله مخطط السياق.

questions.question: ERD stands for...
questions.explanation: ERD is the Entity Relationship Diagram, the data model of entities and their links.
questions.explanation_ar: ERD هو مخطط العلاقات بين الكيانات، أي نموذج بيانات الكيانات وروابطها.

questions.question: The basic concepts of the ER model are...
questions.explanation: The ER model is built from entities, their relationships and their attributes.
questions.explanation_ar: نموذج الكيانات مبني من الكيانات وعلاقاتها وصفاتها.

questions.question: The DFD depicts...
questions.explanation: A DFD tracks data, not control; control flow belongs to other diagrams.
questions.explanation_ar: المخطط يتتبع البيانات لا التحكم، فتدفق التحكم يخص مخططات أخرى.

questions.question: In DFD terms, what is a black hole defect?
questions.question_ar: في مخططات التدفق، ما عيب الثقب الأسود؟
options: a data store that nobody ever accesses
a data flow joining two external entities
a process with input flows but no output
a process that produces outputs without any input
options_en: a data store that nobody ever accesses
a data flow joining two external entities
a process with input flows but no output
a process that produces outputs without any input
questions.explanation: A black hole swallows data: flows go in and nothing comes out of the process.
questions.explanation_ar: الثقب الأسود يبتلع البيانات: تدخل التدفقات ولا يخرج منها شيء.

questions.question: Which data flow connection is illegal in a valid DFD?
questions.question_ar: أي اتصال تدفق غير قانوني في مخطط صحيح؟
options: a process connected to a process
a process connected to a data store
an external entity to a process
a store linked straight to a store
options_en: a process connected to a process
a process connected to a data store
an external entity to a process
a store linked straight to a store
questions.explanation: Two data stores cannot feed each other directly; a process must sit between them.
questions.explanation_ar: لا يمكن لمخزنين أن يتغذيا من بعضهما مباشرة، فلا بد من عملية بينهما.

questions.question: In the data dictionary notation, what does the pair of braces indicate?
questions.question_ar: في ترميز قاموس البيانات، ماذا يدل زوج الأقواس المعقوفة؟
options: an optional data element in it
a choice of one alternative here
options_en: an optional data element in it
a choice of one alternative here
questions.explanation: Braces mean the element may repeat, and the adjacent bounds fix how many times.
questions.explanation_ar: الأقواس تعني أن العنصر قد يتكرر، والحدود المجاورة تحدد عدد المرات.

questions.question: In use case modelling, how does include differ from extend?
questions.question_ar: في نمذجة حالات الاستخدام، كيف يختلف include عن extend؟
options: the two relationships are functionally identical to me now
include always runs shared behaviour; extend adds it optionally
include is optional while extend is mandatory in it now
include links actors only; extend links use cases only here now
options_en: the two relationships are functionally identical to me now
include always runs shared behaviour; extend adds it optionally
include is optional while extend is mandatory in it now
include links actors only; extend links use cases only here now
questions.explanation: Include always pulls in shared behaviour; extend adds behaviour only when a condition holds.
questions.explanation_ar: include يسحب السلوك المشترك دائماً، أما extend فيضيفه عند تحقق شرط.
